```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(rnaturalearthhires)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)


```
### Exercise 1

```{r code-chunk-label}

education <- read_csv("share-of-education-in-government-expenditure.csv") |>
  rename( country = Entity, edu_share = `Government expenditure on education, total (% of government expenditure)`
  )

unemployment <- read_csv("unemployment-rate.csv") |>
  rename(rate = `Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)` 
         )
education <- education |>
  mutate(country = case_when(
    country == "United States" ~ "United States of America",
    country == "Congo" ~ "Republic of the Congo",
    country == "Democratic Republic of Congo" ~ "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
    country == "DR Congo" ~ "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
    country == "Tanzania" ~ "United Republic of Tanzania",
    country == "Russia" ~ "Russian Federation",
    country == "Vietnam" ~ "Viet Nam",
    country == "Iran" ~ "Iran, Islamic Republic of",
    country == "Syria" ~ "Syrian Arab Republic",
    country == "Bolivia" ~ "Bolivia ( Plurinational State of)",
    country == "Venezuela" ~ "Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of )",
    country == "Egypt" ~ "Egypt, Arab Rep.",
      country == "Gambia" ~ "Gambia, The",
    TRUE ~ country
  ))

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")   |>
  mutate(name = case_when(
    name == "United States" ~ "United States of America",
    name == "Republic of Congo" ~ "Republic of the Congo",
    name == "Democratic Republic of the Congo" ~ "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
    name == "Tanzania" ~ "United Republic of Tanzania",
    name == "Russia" ~ "Russian Federation",
    name == "Vietnam" ~ "Viet Nam",
    name == "Iran" ~ "Iran, Islamic Republic of",
    name == "Syria" ~ "Syrian Arab Republic",
    name == "Bolivia" ~ "Bolivia (Plurinational State of)",
    name == "Venezuela" ~ "Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)",
    name == "Egypt" ~ "Egypt, Arab Rep.",
    name == "The Gambia" ~ "Gambia, The",
    TRUE ~ name
  ))
edu_years <- sort(unique(education$Year))
unemp_years <- sort(unique(unemployment$Year))
my_cutpoints <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)
my_colors <- c("#f7fcd0", "#dff2b4", "#b8e186", "#7fbc41", "#4d9221", "#276419")
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Global Education & Unemployment Dashboard"),
  tags$hr(),
  tabsetPanel(
  tabPanel( "Education Map",
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          sliderInput("map_year","Select Year:",
            min = min(edu_years),
            max = max(edu_years),
            value = max(edu_years),
            step = 1,
            sep = ""),
          p("World choropleth map of government expenditure on education as % of total government spending.")),
mainPanel( h3("Education spending as % of government expenditure"),
          plotlyOutput("mymap", height = "520px"),
          tags$br(),
          img(src = "legend.png", width = "100%", height = "70px")
        ) ) ) ,
    tabPanel( "Unemployment Lines",
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          selectizeInput("unemp_country",
            "Select countries or regions:",
            choices = sort(unique(unemployment$Entity)),
            multiple = TRUE,
            selected = c("United States", "France", "South Africa")
          ),
sliderInput(
            "unemp_year",
            "Year Range:",
            min = min(unemp_years),
            max = max(unemp_years),
            value = c(min(unemp_years), max(unemp_years)),
            step = 1,
            sep = "" ),
          p("Interactive comparison of unemployment trends over time.")
        ),
   mainPanel(  h3("Unemployment rate over time"),
          plotlyOutput("unemp_plot", height = "450px")
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  map_data <- reactive({
    world |>
    left_join(
    education |>
    filter(Year == input$map_year),
    by = c("name" = "country")
      )
  })
  output$mymap <- renderPlotly({
df <- map_data()
 map <- ggplot() +
      geom_sf(
        data = df |> filter(is.na(edu_share)),
        aes(geometry = geometry, text = paste0( name, "<br>", input$map_year, "<br>", "% of government expenditure<br>","No data")
           ),
        fill = "white",
        color = "grey80",
        size = 0.1
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = df |> filter(!is.na(edu_share)),
        aes( geometry = geometry, fill = edu_share, text = paste0(name, "<br>",input$map_year, "<br>","% of government expenditure<br>", sprintf('%.1f%%', edu_share)
          )
        ),
        color = "white",
        size = 0.1
      ) +
      scale_fill_stepsn(
        colors = my_colors,
        breaks = my_cutpoints,
        limits = c(0, 30),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      coord_sf(xlim = c(-170, 190), ylim = c(-55, 85), expand = FALSE) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
      )
    ggplotly(map, tooltip = "text") |>
      layout(margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0))
  })
  output$unemp_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(input$unemp_country)
    df <- unemployment |>
      filter(
        Entity %in% input$unemp_country,
        Year >= input$unemp_year[1],
        Year <= input$unemp_year[2]
      )
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Year, y = rate, color = Entity)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Unemployment rate (%)") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(df$rate, na.rm = TRUE) + 2)) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("Entity", "Year", "rate"))
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)

```
